title: Triage verdict
description: The only output of the triage reading step. Checked again against the repository before anything is applied. The copy the workflow uses lives at .github/triage/verdict.schema.json and must equal this file.

bucket.description: One bucket, or null exactly when needs_person is set.

needs_person.description: Why a person must place this report, in one sentence; null when a bucket is given.

areas.description: Area ids from the roster given in the prompt.

duplicates.description: Likely duplicates among the issues listed in the prompt.

starter.description: Only for a feature request: the draft for /speckit-specify.

paragraph.description: The request as the reporter made it, 60 to 200 words, what and why, no implementation.

conflicts.description: Constitution principles the request collides with, and what an amendment would have to argue.
